title: DC-area forecast: More nice days ahead this week; weekend rain?
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Clear and seasonably cool this evening, with temperatures dipping through the 50s.

What’s next? Warming into the comfortable 70s tomorrow and perhaps near 80 Thursday, with continued gorgeous sunny days and no real humidity. We're watching if and when a tropical system could bring back rain chances at some point this weekend.

Forecast in detail

Tonight: Mainly clear and cool again with most areas seeing lows in the 40s, but DC could stay up closer to 50, while some north and west suburbs clip the upper 30s. Light winds may go calm late. Confidence: High

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Wednesday): We start to tick up a bit warmer, but it's still very comfortable with low humidity and sunny skies. Highs are in the low to mid-70s as light winds blow from the south. Confidence: High 😎 Nice Day!

Tomorrow night: Mostly clear, comfortable, and not as cool as lows are in the low to mid-50s in most areas along with light winds. Confidence: High

Help sustain an independent Capital Weather by becoming a free or paid supporter. Learn more at capitalweather.com/support-us

A look ahead

Thursday should be our warmest day of the week. Most spots should reach at least the upper 70s, some perhaps into the low 80s. Humidity is still low, as dew points hold in the comfortable 50s. Thursday night is clear again with lows from the low 50s in the outer suburbs to upper 50s in DC. Confidence: High

Friday ushers in slightly cooler air behind a weak cool front. Highs return to the low to mid-70s with mostly sunny skies and still comfortable humidity. Friday night could see a few clouds with lows in the low to mid-50s. Confidence: High

For the weekend, we're watching the potential impact of a tropical system forming in the Gulf of Mexico this week. Saturday should see increasing clouds by later in the day with highs in the low to mid-70s. If the system makes it this far north, rain could arrive at some point Saturday night or Sunday, with Sunday highs aiming for the upper 60s to low 70s. Confidence: Low-Medium

Next week could start with a rain threat continuing into Monday, depending on the track and timing of that tropical system. But then a drying trend should follow through midweek with highs in the 60s and 70s.

DC weather history for October 6

A remarkable October 1941 heat wave brought three straight record highs, including a 93-degree day during one of the hottest stretches ever observed so late in the season.

Today’s daily digit — 9/10: A slightly cool but absolutely awesome autumn day. We can soak it in and enjoy, as we look forward to at least a few more sunny days ahead too! | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.
